title: BareBones x AlexMobs
description: All AlexMobs textures redesigned in the Barebones style.
body:
![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3082ca3a421136f1d0a94c527ba1d3d445535dbf.png)

Simply a texture pack that retexturizes the alexmobs in barebones style.

![Test](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9eb92c2f942e7a29f89a3e5227e1b01d01c10185.png)

# ⚠️CREDITS

Texture style https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/bare-bones

For the mod https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/alexs-mobs

# ⚠️CONSIDER

You can use this texture pack as long as you give your respective credits and without modifying the description and image of this texture pack.

Undoubtedly there may be some textures that are missing retouches, so I will be releasing updates until it is 100% ready.
